stemMarkdown: Find the remainder when $82 \times 832$ is divided by $7$.
solutionMarkdown: Reduce each factor first: $82 \equiv 5$ and $832 \equiv 6 \pmod{7}$. So the product is $\equiv 5 \times 6 = 30 \equiv 2 \pmod{7}$.
altSolutionMarkdown: Reducing before multiplying keeps the numbers small — the remainder is unaffected.
